right_adjust.title: Popup Adjustment
right_adjust.description: When popup is expanded and extends beyond screen, automatically adjust map view position

audio.title: Sound Effects
audio.description: Enable or disable interface sound effects

hover.title: Mouse Hover Detection Response Time
hover.description: Mouse hover detection response time on map markers, shorter time requires higher performance

adjust_view.title: Auto Adjust View
adjust_view.description: When map extends beyond screen, automatically adjust map view position to ensure visibility

wasd_move_speed.title: WASD Control Movement Speed
wasd_move_speed.description: WASD movement speed, higher value means faster speed

player_position.title: Player Position Sync
player_position.description: Show your real-time Endfield position on the map as a blue pulsing marker, synced from Skland
player_position.need_login: Log in and bind an Endfield role to show your position on the map in real time

follow_tier.title: Follow my layer
follow_tier.description: Uses the position and height synced from Skland to tell which layer (cave, floor, etc.) you are on, and opens that layer map as you enter or leave it

enabled.title: Enable AI assistant
enabled.description: Show the assistant on the map toolbar. Ask in plain language to find markers, mark them in bulk and plan collection routes

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Root URL of any OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Stored on this device only. Requests go straight from your browser to the provider and never reach ZMDMAP servers

model.title: Model
model.description: Test the connection to load the model list, or type a model name yourself

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Lower is steadier. Keep it at 0 - 0.3 for marker lookups and route planning

panel.placeholder: Ask anything... Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line
panel.not_configured: No AI provider configured yet. Add the base URL and API key of any OpenAI-compatible service to get started.

suggestion.nearby_chest: Which chests near me are still unmarked?
suggestion.plan_route: Plan a collection route over 15 unmarked ether nodes near the view
suggestion.progress: How much of each marker type have I collected on this map?

error.not_configured: Configure an AI provider and model in settings first
error.tool_rounds_exceeded: Reached the tool-call limit. Try breaking the question into smaller steps.

tool.route_saved: Planned {{num}} markers, about {{distance}} in total, saved as a route

cache.title: Cache
cache.success: Cache cleared successfully, refresh page to take effect

state_data.title: State Data
state_data.success: State data cleared successfully, refresh page to take effect
state_data.description: Includes map position state, current viewing map state, clustering settings, electric pole and custom point visibility settings, and other non-critical content

entity_data.title: Marker Data
entity_data.success: Marker data cleared successfully, refresh page to take effect
entity_data.description: Includes different marker type visibility filter states, all marker marking states, all marker states will be reset after clearing

storage_data.title: Storage Data
storage_data.confirm: [Dangerous Operation] Are you sure you want to delete all data? This action cannot be undone! Deleted data includes state data, marker filter data, marking data, all electric pole data and custom point data.
storage_data.success: All storage data cleared successfully, refresh page to take effect
storage_data.failed: Failed to clear all storage data: {{reason}}
storage_data.description: [Dangerous Operation] Delete all stored data, including state data, marker filter data, all electric pole data and custom point data

copy_sentry_ids.title: Error Diagnostics
copy_sentry_ids.description: Copy the device ID or recent Sentry events so support can trace errors and replays for the same device
copy_sentry_ids.empty: No Sentry event IDs stored yet

recruit.title: Recruitment
recruit.description: We need some game-loving computer experts and UI designers. To ensure the continuous development of the map tool, optimize user experience, and ensure code quality after open-sourcing during public beta, we need you to join us.
recruit.point1: Familiar with game data analysis to help us better understand map-related data
recruit.point2: Familiar with backend development, server operations, CI/CD
recruit.point3: Familiar with frontend development frameworks and tools, especially React framework and OpenLayers
